target_runtime_parity.note: There is no independent replay-oracle path for a bare flip_within_horizon target: research_workflow/target_replay_oracle.py::replay supports only 'ordered_barrier', and replay_expression only 'composite'. Parity for a plain flip target is established by READINESS R10 (real-output parity vs the collection-time feature contract) + PREFLIGHT RUNTIME_CONTRACT_BINDING + causal audit pass 14 (field-by-field verification that _emit_observation -> FlipTargetRuntime.from_disposition is a behaviour-preserving refactor of the old inline labeling dict) + the deterministic smoke-day flip-label reproduction recorded below.

horizon_boundary_convention.statement: A prevailing-1m-regime flip whose completed-1m-bar confirmation lands at exactly T + 180s (T + 180000000000 ns) is POSITIVE / within horizon. A flip strictly after T + 180s is NEGATIVE / outside horizon.

agreement.collector_live_inline_path: INCLUSIVE - research_workflow/generic_collector.py::_sweep_elapsed_horizons holds a candidate whose horizon ends exactly at now_ts for one more tick ('horizon_end == now_ts and not final'), so a coincident 1m flip (dispatched after the same-timestamp 1s bar) lands POSITIVE (causal audit pass 01, parent study).
agreement.FlipTargetRuntime._terminal_pending: INCLUSIVE upper - 'start < ts <= limit', limit = horizon_end when no gap (dead code for this study; a bare flip target never enters the pending path)
agreement.replay_oracle._replay_flip_condition: INCLUSIVE upper - 'T < ts <= end' (composite-oracle flip child; closest independent implementation)
agreement.compiled_target_contract: horizon_seconds: 180 / censoring_policy.max_horizon_seconds: 180; no explicit operator field -- silent, consistent with the inclusive runtime implementation, does not contradict it

horizon_boundary_convention.verification: studies/clean_maturity_flip_model_180s_horizon/_work/verify_horizon_boundary_convention.py -- 3 assertions PASS (FlipTargetRuntime legacy path, replay oracle flip child, collector inline-guard source). Kept in _work/ (not tests/) so it does not enter the execution closure and stale the seal.
horizon_boundary_convention.lower_bound_nuance: The collector, oracle, and pending-runtime use exclusive-at-T ('T < ts'); _terminal_legacy uses inclusive-at-T. Immaterial for this study: a flip at exactly the decision instant T is not a forward event and the 5s candidate cadence + 1s-before-1m dispatch means it never fires.
